By Dr. Elias Akleh
It is Easter now when Christians celebrate Jesus’ resurrection. I invite you to imagine for a moment the following hypothetical scenario during this important religious celebration:
Christian Iranians (yes, there are many Christians in Iran) usually attend this service in Saint Sarkis Cathedral, the largest church in the capital Tehran, Iran.
Unfortunately for these Christians, the extremist Islamic Iranian government covets the strategic piece of land where the church stands. It wants to build the largest-ever mosque instead. So, it built a high separation wall around the church and erected strict checkpoints manned by fully geared and armed soldiers on all paths leading to the church to intimidate and prevent Christian worshippers from attending service.
Despite these obstacles, thousands of Christians climb the separation wall and storm the checkpoints in thousands to reach the church and celebrate this important religious occasion.
Saint Sarkis Cathedral
, is the biggest church in Tehran, Iran.
This year the Iranian soldiers savagely raided and violated the sanctity of the church breaking its contents, ribbing, stepping on, and torching the holy Bible, firing smoke and concussion grenades, shooting worshippers with rubber bullets, dragging women and children on the floor all the way outside, beating worshippers with batons and rifle buts, arresting many worshippers and dragging them out of the church like sheep dragged for slaughter.
Saint Sarkis Cathedral
Now imagine the reactions to such a raid by the Christian Western World, especially by the United States. There would be the strongest condemnations by every president and statesman, condemnations by the Pope and every Christian denomination, imposing the strictest economic sanctions, directing the Security Council to issue the harshest ever condemnation, and might lead to some military confrontation.
Yet when the extremist Talmudic far-right terrorist Israeli government sent hundreds of its fully armed soldiers last week to raid and violate the sanctity of the Islamic Al-Aqsa Mosque during the Islamic holiest month of Ramadan breaking its contents, ribbing and stepping on and torching the Islamic holy book, the Qur’an, fire smoke and concussion grenades, use tear gas, shoot worshippers with rubber bullets, drag women and children on the floor all the way outside, beat worshippers with batons and rifle buts, arrest many worshippers and drag them out of the mosque, you hear only mild fake concerns and shy calls for calm from the Christian Western World.
Youtube video of Israeli savage raid on Al-Aqsa
Such raids and violations of the Al-Aqsa Mosque by the violent Israeli forces had become a weekly routine, almost every Friday. These raids usually intensify during the holy month of Ramadan when hundreds of thousands of Moslem Palestinians climb over the separation wall and storm many Israeli checkpoints in order to attend prayer in the Al-Aqsa Mosque in the Old City. This year, with the extremist Talmudic far-right Israeli government, the raid was the harshest and happened in three consecutive days despite all the warnings by the Palestinian resistance factions, and by many Arab leaders.
Climbing the separation wall to pray in Al-Aqsa Mosque
Israeli weekly attacks on Moslem women & men worshippers in Al-Aqsa
The brutality of these latest Israeli raids prompted a Jordanian-Palestinian-Arab League coordination backed by the UAE and China to request an emergency session by the UN Security Council to discuss these Israeli violations and to defend the Palestinians’ unalienable freedom rights of worship. Yet the White House, as usual, blocked the Security Council from issuing any condemnation against Israel. The White House expressed its usual fake “grave concern” about the violence taking place in East Jerusalem and “urged all parties to avoid further escalation.”
The White House routinely acknowledges the existence of tension and violence, yet it shies away from recognizing and admitting who the perpetrator is. John Kirby, a spokesperson for the White House National Security Council echoed the White House’s pathetic statement:
“More than ever, it is imperative that Israelis and Palestinians work together to reduce these tensions and restore calm.”
An examining look at American history reveals that successive American administrations had been the aggressive guardian dog for Israel since its illegal inception in 1948. The US administrations ignore the well-being of their own citizens by siphoning their tax money to provide Israelis with the best medical coverage, the best and completely free education, gift Israel the latest weapons to continue terrorizing the Middle Eastern region, and sacrifice the lives of American soldiers fighting wars for Israel that incite Arab hatred against the US.
All this and more despite Israeli treasonous attacks against American citizens and assets, such as the Lavon Affair, assassinations of Kennedy members, the USS-Liberty attack, and 911 to mention just a few. Israel also stole American vital military technologies and sold them to its rivals, and stole American uranium and nuclear devices among many other hostile behaviors.
Such an illogical American-skewed love affair with Israel encouraged the Israelis to increase their oppression against Palestinians that has been greatly intensified since the formation of the latest Netanyahu’s government late last year, a government considered by the Israeli majority as the most extremist government ever in the history of Israel. Pushed by the
Israeli far-right think tank Kohelet Policy Forum
, which is funded mainly by Zionist American Jewish billionaires Arthur Dantchik and Jeffrey Yass, Netanyahu’s government pushed to overhaul the Israeli judicial system so that Netanyahu could avoid all the corruption charges against him. This overhaul attempt caused massive demonstrations in every major Israeli city to topple the government. Seeking such confrontation Netanyahu’s government increased its aerial bombardments against Syrian targets, increased its undercover terrorist operations against Iranian assets, and organized raids against Palestinian cities to assassinate Palestinian political leaders and to demolish “non-permit” homes.
Fully armed special Israeli military team routinely raided major Palestinian cities and refugee camps such as Jenin, Nablus, and Huwwara during the early dawn hours, attack a particular Palestinian house with rockets killing its residents and whoever happens to be in the neighborhood, and arrest some young Palestinians using them as human shields while retreating from the city. Armed illegal extremist Israeli colonial settlers under the protection and encouragement of the Israeli army were also encouraged to attack small Palestinian villages burning their vehicles, destroying their shops, hurling torches through home windows, firing live ammunition, cutting fruit trees, and destroying crops among many other terrorist attacks.
Palestinians, who had enough of these Israeli terror raids, organized to defend themselves with whatever simple weapons they could acquire. They started confronting Israeli extremist settlers and soldiers at checkpoints and inflict some casualties among them. This Palestinian self-defense was met by Israeli extremist officials such as the new Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich and National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir inciting extremist armed Israeli colonial settlers to intensify their terror attacks against Palestinians. Smotrich called for “wiping out” the city of Huwwara after the casualty of two Israeli soldiers. On February 26th hundreds of these
armed Israeli colonial settlers attacked the city
, torching everything they encounter in their way, burning many homes and localities.
Video of Huwwara attacked and torched by Israeli extremist settlers.
Zvika Fogel, another far-right extremist parliament member welcomed the settler’s terrorist attacks against Huwwara. She celebrated this violence by stating:
“A terrorist came out of Huwwara – and Huwwara was closed and burned … this is what I want to see. That’s the only way we’ll achieve deterrence … after a murder like Sunday, villages should burn when the Israeli army does not act.”
This “wiping out” of Palestinian cities is not a unique incident in Israeli history. Since its illegal establishment and throughout all its history continuing to the present moment successive Israeli governments had adopted a
policy of ethnic cleansing and “incremental genocide”
(as described by Jewish political science professor Illan Peppe) against Palestinians in 1948 with the wiping out of the face of the earth of 500 Palestinian villages and towns.
During his visit to France on March 19th.
Smotrich preached to an enthusiastic pro-Zionist crowd of supporters
that:
“There is no such thing as Palestinians because there’s no such thing as the Palestinian people … the Palestinian people is an invention that is less than 100 years old.”
He was reiterating the Zionist racist colonial myth that Palestine was a “land without people for a people without land”, which was constantly repeated by all
former Israeli Prime Ministers the famous of whom was Golda Meir during an interview
with the Sunday Times in 1969 when she stated that “There was no such thing as Palestinians … they did not exist.”
Finally, the incessant brutal raids against the Al-Aqsa Mosque broke the camel’s back. Netanyahu finally had his seek for war. What he really wanted was a military skirmish, not a real war. Israeli intelligence guesstimated that Hezbollah has the capability of launching 1,000 missiles per day, some of which are precision targeting missiles, against Israel, and that they have around 150,000 missiles, meaning that the firing of missiles would continue for 150 days non-stop, which would devastate Israel and push Israelis back to the “stone age” to quote Israeli military officials.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu holds a press conference at the Ministry of Defense in Tel Aviv on April 10, 2023. Photo by Tomer Neuberg/FLASH90
To avoid war with Hezbollah the Israeli cabinet accused the Hamas faction of launching these rockets from both sides of Lebanon and Gaza. Israel does not have the courage to engage Hezbollah forces yet can show strength against weaker Hamas factions in Gaza. Yet, to save face Israeli artillery fired few shells at an empty field in Lebanon but sent its fighter planes to bomb locations in Gaza claimed to be Hamas military bases.
When Palestinian freedom fighters killed three Israeli female soldiers in retaliation to Israeli aggression defense minister Yoav Gallant issued the following threatening statement:
“We will not allow terrorists (Palestinians) to turn our days of holiday (Passover) into a time of sadness and mourning.”
But this is precisely what Israel has been doing to Palestinians for the last few decades during every holy month of Ramadan by attacking worshippers at Al-Aqsa Mosque, attacking Palestinian cities, and bombing Gaza turning this Islamic religious holiday into a time of violence, murdering, fear, sadness, and mourning. Extremist settlers demand the army turn every Palestinian town into a concentration prison like Gaza. Other Israelis, such as parliament member Zvika Fogel, finance minister Bezalel Smotrich and national security minister Itmar Ben-Gvir, are demanding more violence and terror attacks again Palestinian cities and intensification of raids on Al-Aqsa to evacuate Moslem worshippers and to turn the Mosque into the alleged Solomon Temple where extremist religious Talmudists could sacrifice goats and celebrate feasts freely.
Israeli politicians had made it clearly obvious that right-wing extreme elitist racist and terrorist ideology is an essential requirement to succeed in Israeli politics. One example is how Itamar Ben-Gvir rose from being a youth leader of the extremist Kach party to becoming Israel’s national security minister. Kach party was founded by extremist Rabbi Meir Kahane, whose ideal ideology was “The immediate transfer of the Arabs, who are considered as dogs, who must sit quietly or get the hell out.”
Despite the Palestinian rockets fired at southern and northern Israeli illegal settlers in response to Israel’s raid on Al-Aqsa Mosque, and despite the warnings of all the neighboring Arab leaders, Ben-Gvir requested an increase in the number of Israeli soldiers and police within the Al-Aqsa compound to evacuate, by force if necessary, the Moslem worshipper so that extremist Talmudic Jews can sacrifice their goat in the Al-Aqsa compounds peacefully in celebration of Jewish Passover. Such an act would start an international religious war by evoking the anger of all Moslems nations, who constitute the second-largest world religious community with about 1.8 billion followers.
While, on one hand, every Zionist Jewish Israeli citizen, 18 years and older, females, and males, are in reality soldiers in the terrorist Israeli army conscripted to murder Palestinians to steal their homeland and to erect militarized terrorizing colonies, the Palestinians, on the other hand, are fighting for their lives, for their freedom, and for their own homeland.
So, Mr. Yoav Gallant, I ask you here, who are really the terrorists? Aren’t they you and your whole Israeli state plus all the Western countries that protect and support your terror?
